title: confiture migrate schema-to-schema migrate --format json
description: Rows copied into the target for every entry of the column-mapping YAML (--mapping), in the file's order, by one strategy. The CLI assembles it. A failure writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead of this shape.

strategy.description: The --strategy every table was migrated with.

migrated.description: Rows inserted, by the mapping file's entry name (the target table unless the entry sets target_table).

additionalProperties.description: Rows inserted into the entry's target table.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
